    How to use Northstar

    Overview: review changes and check whether data is current. Research: explore companies and the reasons behind a score. Portfolio: record holdings, cash and transactions. Strategy lab: inspect experiments and saved forward results.

    Account performance measures your recorded holdings and cash flows. A historical proxy models today's holdings in the past. A paper cohort follows a saved research list without real trades. These answer different questions.

    Drawdown: a fall from an earlier peak. Volatility: how much returns vary. Basis point: 0.01 percentage points. A score is a ranking signal, not a probability of profit.

    If a result is unavailable, follow its coverage message. Check your ticker and currency, refresh data, and reconcile holdings/cash before relying on account returns. Do not replace missing data with guesses.

    Methodology, data sources & export

    A transparent starting point

    Enter your current Nordnet holdings and weighted average purchase price. Use zero shares for a watchlist company. Norwegian provider tickers end in .OL. For NOK holdings you can enter a bare Oslo ticker such as KOG; the suffix is added during lookup.

    Refresh requests five years of daily price history and USD/NOK from an unofficial Yahoo Finance endpoint. Availability is not guaranteed. Prices may be delayed. Every quote shows its provider timestamp; quotes older than four calendar days are excluded from NOK valuation. USD holdings also require a fresh NOK exchange rate.

    Alerts use your price levels, a 200-session price average, and your chosen position concentration limit, including manually tracked cash, when every holding is priced. These are review prompts, not validated investment recommendations. The Recommendations page adds technical ranking and background analysis. Explore also shows available annual financial figures, sources and dates. Official announcement metadata is shown separately from ranks; Source-linked annual assessments, transaction imports, cash reconciliation and optional open-tab desktop alerts are available. Full-report news interpretation, tax calculations and automatic trades are not implemented.

    Keep shares and average cost updated after trades and stock splits. Review corporate actions with your broker. The research worker refreshes holdings and the candidate universe at the configured interval while the server is running.

    Your records are stored in the Northstar server’s SQLite database. Export a notebook copy below; it does not include transaction history or the research archive. A complete backup requires the server database. This application does not connect to your Nordnet account.

    Event sources & upcoming dates

    Dividend amounts use the provider’s reported currency and historical basis. Markers annotate the existing series; dividends are not added to already adjusted prices. Missing earnings dates are not inferred from fiscal year ends. Issuer event history is limited to retained source notices; this is not a complete earnings archive.

    Selected period

    How these statistics are measured

    Selected-window returns use the first and last displayed closes. Volatility uses the sample standard deviation of daily simple returns, annualised with 252 sessions. Historical 95% VaR is the interpolated 5th-percentile daily loss; expected shortfall averages the worst 5% probability mass. Both are sample descriptions, not maximum possible losses or forecasts. Risk ratios assume a zero risk-free rate. Comparison returns, correlation and beta use shared UTC dates; at least 20 shared-date return intervals are required for correlation and beta. Missing dates are not filled. Drawdown in the lower chart uses the peak of all loaded history; selected-period drawdown starts at the visible window.

    Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · keyboard +/− and arrows · EMA20: teal · MA50: gold · MA200: blue · bands: purple · comparison: orange, aligned at the first shared date in the visible period.

    Annual history & calculation notes

    Revenue growth compares consecutive annual periods only. Margins and debt ratios require matching fiscal dates and known matching currencies. The P/E proxy uses the latest quote and annual diluted EPS; it is not a trailing-twelve-month ratio. Share-count changes can reflect splits or acquisitions, as well as new issuance. Debt ratios require sector context, especially for banks and insurers.

    Research settings & methodology

    The default universe contains 180 Oslo tickers from a dated listing snapshot (26 October 2026). It is broad, but not a complete or automatically maintained exchange directory. Add up to 500 tickers; missing data and liquidity exclusions are shown. Snapshot source ↗

    Overall score: Trend 30%, Momentum 25%, Risk 20%, Timing 15%, Liquidity 10%. Trend measures price relative to 50/200-session averages. Momentum combines 3/6-month returns scaled by volatility. Risk penalises historical volatility and maximum drawdown. Timing uses RSI, MACD and distance from MA50. Liquidity uses average daily turnover. Each component and its explanation is available in the explorer.

    Top-20 ranking and buy signals share one entry policy: at least 200 recent daily observations, matching currency, all four trend conditions, the configured turnover floor with 15 valid observations, volatility below 50%, and daily close less than 15% above MA50. Component scores order qualifying entries. Other stocks retain diagnostic scores without entry ranks. These scores are not probabilities or validated forecasts.

    Holdings: consider reducing when close is below its 200-session average and three-month momentum is negative. Your lower/upper price levels take priority for sell/profit reviews. Failing the entry rules alone does not trigger selling. Position, sector and reserve limits can add separate reductions in the share-count plan. No optimal execution date or future price is predicted. Historical series use adjusted close when the provider supplies it; charts label the basis.

    The worker runs while the Python process is running, even with the browser closed. It does not run while the computer is asleep or off. Local AI requires Ollama plus a downloaded model. Enable it above after setup: ollama pull qwen2.5:3b. There are no paid API calls; hardware and electricity are yours.

    Your allocation settings

    Enter cash available in the account you track here and one total budget shared across the buy plan. The fee limit defaults to 2% of stock value. A technical sale review defaults to 25% of a holding, rounded up; set it to 0 to disable that rule. Starting limits are illustrative settings, not recommended allocations. Update cash manually after real trades.

    Purchase fee: 79 kr per order, regardless of share count, using your stated Nordnet fee. Budgets include this fee. Selling fees are not yet modelled.

    Classify sectors

    Company metadata is looked up automatically using exact Oslo tickers. Available sourced sector labels are used unless you override them here. Unknown or expired classifications remain unclassified; no sector is guessed from a company name. Unclassified holdings prevent confirming sector capacity. Diversified businesses may not fit one sector well.

    Transactions, imports & cash reconciliation

    Transaction history & cash reconciliation

    1. Verify an opening snapshot

    First import your current holdings CSV and verify available cash in Portfolio fit. Choose the date those holdings and cash represent, after all activity that day. Earlier and same-day transactions are history only; later new transactions change holdings and cash. Reinitializing keeps transaction history.

    2. Import a transaction-history CSV

    This is a different file from the holdings export. Map the columns once. Net cash must be signed and include actual broker charges; the estimated 79 kr purchase fee is never added again. Only NOK cash and Oslo stock transactions are supported. Transfers and unsupported events require reconciliation. A split needs a separate mapped split-ratio column (for example 2:1), zero net cash, and a confirmed ticker; quantities are never guessed from broker share deltas.

    Check against your Nordnet cash balance

    A mismatch withholds share-count plans until resolved. Import missing transactions or correct the verified opening snapshot; this check does not overwrite cash.

    Recent imported activity

    Strategy lab

    Test the shared technical entry/exit policy with monthly decisions and equal-weight sizing. Holdings remain until an exit signal; vacant slots use the highest-scoring qualifying entries. Personal confirmation periods, review prices and portfolio limits are not simulated. Signals use only observations through the decision close; simulated changes execute at the next common session’s close. Empty selections stay in cash. This is research, not a prediction.

    Your fixed purchase fee is 79 kr per buy order. The purchase fee is not charged per share. Selling commission is configured below; additional slippage applies in both directions.
